avis.titre: Fine on its own but not under makeup

Not greasy, absorbs quick. One product for sunscreen, moisturizer and primer. Love it. Found something I will use for a long time.
I enjoy this product! It adds a nice glow to your skin, doesn't leave a white cast.

avis.titre: I am a huge fan of this product!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A lot of face sunscreens are too oily for me and make me sweat more. I like this because it went on nice and light without too strong of a scent. My only complaint is that it's super runny when it comes out so there might be more product than you need.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My usual SPF product is Supergoop Unseen Sunscreen. I was offered this product to sample and give my opinion. It isn't a bad product, and seemed to be effective. However, I prefer the texture of the other product more, as it served as a primer as well under makeup. I would recommend this product.
I may cry if this ever gets continued. Its amazing! The world has needed a good SPF/Primer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Decent product, kind of oily but to be expected with a sunscreen. Not the greatest for oily skin but could be beneficial in the winter. Covers smoothly.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Hello Sunshine sunscreen has a really nice feel and absorbs well into the skin. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very nice finish, my face feels powdered and soft. The tube is the perfect size for my makeup bag. The cream spread easily over my dry skin and absorbed fast. Will buy for the summer. Feel great for a winter sunscreen.
So many face sunscreens pill on my face after I put them on. Not this one. This one is lightweight, not sticky, and is an amazing primer for my foundation. I love it so much.

avis.titre: Takes a bit to absorb and iffy for oily skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT sunscreen has an ok-formula- I tend to have to go through different brands and versions before finding the right skincare for me as I have oily skin. This sunscreen is a little on the heavier and thus oiler side for me. It took a while for it to really sink in and absorb so that made doing my makeup a little bit more difficult and time consuming. I would def keep this on those beach days or no make up days doing stuff around the yard or errands.

Ideal product for sensitive skin. No irritation. No shine. Perfect application. Your makeup applies evenly and perfectly after product dries. My daughter and I tried this product and we didn't get sunburn at all. A lot better quality than other facial sunscreen products.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This IT Cosmetics Hello Sunshine Invisible Sunscreen for Face SPF 50 is absolutely amazing. It's a true multitasking product, working as a hydrating face cream, broad-spectrum sunscreen, and a makeup primer all in one. My makeup applies flawlessly over it, and I love that there's no white cast when I first apply it. It feels lightweight yet very hydrating on the skin. My skin has an instant glow after applying this sunscreen. I absolutely love this product and highly recommend it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product was ok but left my skin feeling super greasy, which is not typical of my skin type. I wanted to like this product, but unfortunately fell short of expectations.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sunscreen is nice enough, it was hard to say for sure how much it was working as I generally get less sun exposure this time of year and it was such a small sample size I didn't get to try it multiple times. It was lightweight!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product to use as a primer before your foundation or all on its own. It does not peel or pill under other make up! Hydrating and helps my skin to look better.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First, I like the packaging, it's in a squeeze tube, makes it easy to apply. This is lightweight and sinks into the skin quickly. I have worn this everyday under my makeup and my makeup goes on easily. It has very little scent and has no white cast. Overall, I have enjoy this product, and feel that a little goes a long way.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm very fair and a sunscreen fanatic! I must try 15-20 a year. This one checks all the boxes. It's not greasy, leaves no white cast and melts right in. No breakouts either! I use it on my face, neck and hands daily. Love it!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've tried a few products from IT Cosmetics, but never a sunscreen. I have many facial sunscreens that I've bought, from many different brands, but I always love trying out new ones. This seems like a really great product! I love that it has 50 spf, as I have a light complexion and freckle easily. I'm also over 50 now, so I'm really trying to avoid new fine lines on my face. This is a liquid serum sunscreen, and it smoothes onto skin easily. It soaks in quickly too, and doesn't leave any white cast. It feels very hydrating due to the hyaluronic acid, and it would be a nice primer before applying makeup. I did not wear makeup over this, but I'm sure it would do well since there was no pilling noticeable, and because it was so hydrating and smoothing. I will most likely be purchasing this product in the future, once I've used up my current products.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the IT Cosmetics hydrating sunscreen serum as the last step of my morning routine for several months now and I highly recommend it. The serum is a white lotion-like consistency and melts right into my skin, leaving no trace of whiteness on my brown skin. It has a very light scent that I don't really notice and it doesn't interfere with other products I use. I also love that it does not have that greasy feeling that a lot of sunscreens can have. I have dry skin and I do feel that my thirsty skin instantly feels more hydrated with this serum, it also gives it a nice glow, and my skin feels smooth with the results lasting all day. It has gotten extremely cold now with temperatures cold enough for it to snow and I have continued to use this sunscreen since I believe in protecting my skin all year round. The sunscreen has been keeping my skin glowing, smooth, and hydrated even in these cold and windy temperatures!

avis.titre: Pleasant smell and no eye burn
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The color scheme of the sunscreen reminded me of the super goop, unseen sunscreen. But the texture was completely different. It was more like a normal sunscreen lotion. It went on and absorbed quickly. It had a pleasant smell. It did not cause any breakouts that I could tell. I could see myself wearing this often. It was not too greasy, and did not sting my eyes which is the most important thing to me in a face sunscreen.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received Hello Sunshine 3 in 1 by it. I like that It's 3 products in one, you have an invisible sunscreen spf 50. Hydrating serum plus primer. It's non greasy and make-up friendly, with a light scent and no white residue like normal sunscreen leaves.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin is pretty sensitive so I always use new products cautiously. I was pleasantly surprised - my skin loved it. I was looking for a moisturizing sunscreen that would layer well with makeup. Many sunscreens can be very drying, especially when you're on a retinol regiment. This sunscreen, however, doesn't dry out my face at all, even in my extra dry patches. It layers well with makeup also. I've been using this for the past month and I will definitely be re-purchasing.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this sunscreen. I was excited to try it, and it exceeded my expectations. It is very lightweight and leaves zero white cast. It is incredibly hydrating and sits beautifully under my makeup. An added bonus is that it's filled with skin-loving ingredients like Pro-Vitamin B5 and Hyaluronic Acid. I'm so glad that I discovered this serum/primer—it has quickly become an essential part of my beauty routine.

avis.titre: This brown-skin-friendly SPF 50 sunscreen hydrates, primes,

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a God send in a little tube. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoyed protecting my face before my makeup since it has a hydration and primer included or days I didn't wear any make up it still worked like a charm, I can have my face protected by the sunscreen. I absolutely love this invisible sunscreen! It goes on completely clear with no residue at all, and it feels so lightweight on my skin. It also works great under the eyes without settling or causing irritation. This has definitely become my go-to everyday sunscreen!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] No white cast is always a plus! (As I am a woman of color). It's a little watery, but easy to put on. Maybe a little greasy, but I am a bit oily. Great to have on hand for travel as a 3-in-1! No discernible scent.

avis.titre: Does exactly what it says..a must have!

avis.titre: My New Favorite Portable Invisible Sunscreen
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Review – Invisible Sunscreen (Portable Version) I absolutely loved this invisible sunscreen, especially the portable version. The bottle's nozzle is another big plus because it dispenses the perfect amount of product with no waste. The texture leaves a beautiful, glowy finish without making the skin look greasy. It doesn't leave any white cast, it's not sticky, and it keeps the skin nicely hydrated. Overall, it's an easy-to-use, convenient sunscreen that fits perfectly into a daily routine. I definitely recommend this product.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Hello Sunshine Invisible Sunscreen and I'm really into it. This product applies nicely, and doesn't leave any whote cast. It looks good for about 15 minutes, and then the oil slick on my face starts. I am an oily skinned gal to begin with, this just exacerbates it. I love the brand and feel this product would be better suited for normal to dry skin.

This was my first sunscreen purchase from IT. I had been using Neutrogena but it had a watery feel so I tried IT and am happy that I did. This has a nice creamy feel, but not an oily feel at all. You can put your face primer overtop and it doesn't feel heavy. I like it so much that I purchased the larger size on sale.
I'm now purchasing my third tube. I used it every day underneath my makeup. I love how it makes my skin feel. I highly recommend it!

I don't have sensitive skin and usually use the Ordinary, urban rx and good molecule but was referred by ulta lady to get this instead of the ordinary sunscreen and terrible mistake. I broke out so bad with small heat rash all over my face. It looks so bad and looks like hives. Totally would not recommend.

I put this on 3x daily. A lot of people don't realize that wearing sunscreen everday isnt only for sun protection. its for hydration. And holy cow. This stuff is perfect. I have very dry skin, but not anymore. This stuff saved my face. I wash my face AM and PM. Put on toner, brightening serum and hello sunshine in the AM. Mid/late afternoon, i rinse my face, sprtiz on toner then reapply hello sunshine. PM i wash my face, toner, brightening serum, estee lauder under eye, estee lauder face moisturizer, and again, hello sunshine. Sometimes i apply hello sunshine 4x daily, if face is feel crisp, but im telling you. If i wasnt so anal about face care, this would be a stand alone product. Worth the $$.

This sunscreen feels really nice when I apply it, it soaks in nice without making me look oily and leaves my skin pretty soft. It doesn't pill, which is awesome! I found as an actual primer it didn't do much for me, but maybe that is user error. My biggest complaint is that it makes me breakout on my chin, but I have sensitive skin and am yet to find sunscreen that works perfectly on my face.
This product goes on smoothly, no white cast and doesn't clog my pores or cause irritation. I use this every day. Bottle lasts a long time and there's no chemical smell.

Ive tried so many sunscreens, and this one by far is the best one ever! It feels so smooth, it doesnt sting my eyes when i sweat, like other sunscreens do. No piling, and the scent is good. Perfect sunscreen! ☀️

I have dry sensitive skin. During our Florida winter, this worked quite well with minimal tackiness. But today's 95 degree and high humidity weather turned this into a no-go. This was the only skin care product I used under my foundation. My skin did not absorb this at all. I will save it for winter. To add, this product is identical to other Korean sunscreens I have used with better results.

If you are debating on getting this, get it. you will not regret it!! NO whitecast whatsoever, it applies like a serum and its not oily, its very lightweight. You can also reapply it without feeling like there's a film or it's sticky on your face, it really blends and feels amazing. SPF 50!!! BUY IT!!!
The combination of sun protection and skin care was a big bonus! I have oily skin and found the product to enhance the look of excess oiliness.

I really wanted to love this product and gave it several tries before writing this review. I adore the high SPF and primer in one aspect. I couldn't get past the fragrance; to me it was not pleasant and it lingered. It was also SO greasy on my face!! I have dry skin and this just seemed to sit on top of my skin and did nothing. Believe me, I tried everything over several days to get it to set. No go for me.
This is an amazing product! Moisturzer, primer, & spf in one. It's great under makeup & doesn't pill or feel greasy.
super oily and does not accept any type of makeup on top. It crumbles and becomes more oily during the day.

Had to write about this AMAZING product!!! Hands down the bEST SPF moisturizer combo out there and I have tried everything!!!! Hope they never discontinue it! Soooo moisturizing smell fresh doesn't pill! The Best!!
Days later and my eyes are still burning red and irritated and i did not apply near my eyes.

Let this product sit on your skin for at least two minutes before laying products on top. I'm on a mission to finding a good sunscreen underneath makeup. This product makes me so happy. Sets so perfectly underneath product, does not pill, does not have too much fragance and the texture is chefs kiss. 10/10…100/10

avis.titre: It made my eyes burn, sadly
avis.texte: I really wanted this sunscreen to work but unfortunately my skin does not like an ingredient/s in the formula. The first 2 times I wore it I didn't have any problems and thought all was going well until the next time I used it and the several times after it made my eyes burn (for reference I have oily, sensitive skin). I was so disappointed because I really liked how it made my skin look and it doesn't have a strong scent either, but it just didn't agree with my skin. I will finish the tube up and use it on another part of my body, just not on my face. Unfortunately I will not be repurchasing.

What I loved: doesn't leave a greasy finish and looks great underneath foundation. What I didn't love: cystic acne has always been an issue for me. I haven't had a flare in about two years but this changed after using this product. Ruined my skin barrier.
I don't use foundation. I only use a primer and so far this product is the best. I will be a repeat customer. I also liked the affordable price.

The best face sunscreen I've ever used - I've tried all the trendy products from Supergoop to innisfree, but the texture and feel on my skin have always been so unpleasant that I've never been able to stick to a sunscreen routine. This is such a game changer - it feels like a milky serum, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin glowy instead of chalky. I've also basically stopped using primer under my makeup!

There's zero piling, zero irritation, mineral powder foundation stays put and looks fresh ALL day, makes skin look dewey (not powdery), and it's not greasy. This is my new holy grail for primer and sunscreen in one.
